what: IFEval counts highlighted sections as (single-asterisk matches) + (double-asterisk matches); a single '***text***' bold-italic span is matched as both a single '*text*' and a double '**text**', so ONE visual highlight is counted as 2, and a response can satisfy a 'highlight at least N sections' quota it did not really meet.

method.corpus: 6 hand-traced cases; verdict = checker pass/fail vs ground-truth span count.
method.corrected_count: upstream count minus one per '***text***' span (each span is one visual highlight).
method.exposure: across GPT-4 responses to the highlight-requiring prompts: how many use a triple-asterisk span, how many have an inflated count, and in how many the inflation would FLIP the pass/fail verdict; examples kept for manual review.
